narration:1:1260010001:0.text: After defeating all the damedanglers, the magic finally seems to wear off. All fish monsters and damedanglers transform back into ordinary fish...
narration:1:1260010001:0.source_cn: 击退了所有冥湾美人后，魔法似乎终于失效，之前的鱼怪与冥...

say:3:1260010002:0.text: M-My prized catch?! My two-meter-long fish monster?! A brand new chapter of my life?!
say:3:1260010002:0.source_cn: 我、我的宝贵鱼获？！我的两米长鱼怪？！我人生的新篇章！

say:5:1260010003:0.text: My ultimate damedangler haul! Ten casts, ten damedanglers! A brand new milestone!
say:5:1260010003:0.source_cn: 我的冥湾美人大满贯！十竿全出的冥湾美人！我人生的新纪录！

say:9:1260010005:1.text: Huh? Those fish monsters and damedanglers... they're all just normal fish now.
say:9:1260010005:1.source_cn: 哦？这些鱼怪，还有冥湾美人……全都变成普通的鱼了。

say:10:1260010006:0.text: Compared to those who were turned into Graveborns before, the reversion to their true forms this time was noticeably slower.
say:10:1260010006:0.source_cn: 和之前被变成亡灵的那几个小子不一样，这次回复原形的速度...

say:11:1260010007:0.text: Various types of fish feebly flare their gills, devoid of the fierce energy they previously possessed.
say:11:1260010007:0.source_cn: 各种各样的鱼无力地张合着腮，完全没有了之前生龙活虎地攻...

say:14:1260010008:1.text: But they've still returned to their original forms, which is all we could've hoped for!
say:14:1260010008:1.source_cn: 但还是变回原形了，这就比预想得要好太多了！

say:15:1260010009:1.text: 万一真的能永久改变形态，说不定锈锚港明天晚上就要被新的海怪攻城了。
say:15:1260010009:1.source_cn: 万一真的能永久改变形态，说不定锈锚钢明天晚上就要被新的...

say:16:1260010010:1.text: ...Uh, are we really going to ignore those fishermen blubbering over there?
say:16:1260010010:1.source_cn: ……呃，不过，我们真的不管那几个抱头痛哭的钓鱼佬了吗？

say:17:1260010011:1.text: They even gave those weird fish they caught special names... It looked like they were ready to log them in the record books.
say:17:1260010011:1.source_cn: 他们甚至还给那些钓上来的怪东西起了专属的名字呢……看起...

say:18:1260010012:0.text: I honestly don't want to get involved... but alright, these guys have done quite a bit for us in the past.
say:18:1260010012:0.source_cn: 真是不想管他们……算了，这帮家伙平时也帮了我们不少忙。

say:19:1260010013:0.text: After all, they've acted as lookouts, warned us of dangers, and hauled in things they shouldn't have... more times than I can count.
say:19:1260010013:0.source_cn: 毕竟他们在钓鱼间隙帮我们放哨、报告险情、钓上来不该钓的...

say:20:1260010014:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you have any ideas on how to console them?
say:20:1260010014:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you have any ideas on how to console them?
say:20:1260010014:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you have any ideas on how to console them?

choice_prompt:21:1260010014.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you have any ideas on how to console them?
choice_prompt:21:1260010014.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你有什么办法安慰安慰他们吗？
choice_prompt:21:1260010014.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you have any ideas on how to console them?
choice_prompt:21:1260010014.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you have any ideas on how to console them?

say:22:1260010015:0.text: I see. Hey, you all, quit crying! Pay attention!
say:22:1260010015:0.source_cn: 原来如此。喂，你们几个，别哭了！听我说！

say:25:1260010016:0.text: W-What is it? If I'd known I'd lose this precious catch, I would've rather been eaten by them!
say:25:1260010016:0.source_cn: 怎、怎么了？早知道会失去我的宝贝鱼怪，我还不如，还不如...

say:26:1260010017:0.text: My ten-cast streak of damedanglers, do you know how rare that is?! It'll never happen again! Ahhh—
say:26:1260010017:0.source_cn: 我的冥湾美人十连竿，你知道这是多低的概率吗？！再也不会...

say:27:1260010018:0.text: Listen up! These fish were always meant to be ordinary; it was evil magic that turned them into what you saw earlier.
say:27:1260010018:0.source_cn: 你们听好！这些鱼，本来就该是现在的普通样子，只是被邪恶...

say:28:1260010019:1.text: And besides, even if they're just ordinary fish, the sheer number likely exceeds what you've caught before.
say:28:1260010019:1.source_cn: 而且，就算只是普通鱼，单论数量，也超出你们以往的收获了。

say:29:1260010020:1.text: It's possible that magic influenced this, so these fish shouldn't count toward your fishing prowess or career records!
say:29:1260010020:1.source_cn: 这可能也是魔法的影响。所以，它们不能证明你们的钓鱼技术...

say:32:1260010021:1.text: Exactly, just consider it a lucky break and celebrate—there's plenty of fish here, enough to feed you for days!
say:32:1260010021:1.source_cn: 是啊，就当做意外收获，好好庆贺吧——这里的这些鱼也不少...

say:33:1260010022:1.text: N-No... no way! Even if they were affected by magic, I caught them myself, and I'm going to make replicas of them to hang on my wall!
say:33:1260010022:1.source_cn: 不……不行！就算是魔法影响的鱼，也是我亲手钓上来的，我...

say:34:1260010023:1.text: Hmph, back in my day, I caught 101 fish in a single day—way more than now! And there wasn't any magic at work back then!
say:34:1260010023:1.source_cn: 哼，我当年一天钓了一百零一条鱼的时候，可比这会儿多多了...

say:35:1260010024:1.text: Haha, but didn't you get all excited when you caught just two damedanglers this time? So, you do agree that the essence of fishing is quality, not quantity, right?
say:35:1260010024:1.source_cn: 哈，但你这回不是钓上两条冥湾美人就喜笑颜开的——你也认...

say:36:1260010025:1.text: Hmph, says the one who can only catch something once every thirty days! So what if you reeled in 80 kilos with one cast? It still doesn't amount to much per day!
say:36:1260010025:1.source_cn: 哈哈，三十天才能钓上一杆，别说八十斤了，就算一杆钓上八...

say:39:1260010026:1.text: *Sigh* These two have always been rivals. They start bickering the moment they meet. I thought this time would finally put an end to their feud.
say:39:1260010026:1.source_cn: 唉，师父跟“一零一杆”是老对头了，一碰面就要吵架，还以...

say:40:1260010027:1.text: Well, if that's how it is, take some of this rare catch with you. Think of it as nature's gift.
say:40:1260010027:1.source_cn: 算了，既然如此，难得的鱼获，你们也拿点走吧，就当做是大...

say:43:1260010028:1.text: You can have these too. My master and I fish in this area, so the yield will definitely be different from what you usually get.
say:43:1260010028:1.source_cn: 那你们也收下这些吧，我跟我师父平时都在这一带钓鱼，产出...

say:44:1260010029:1.text: Alright, a trade it is! The more we know of each other, the more meaningful our contests will be!
say:44:1260010029:1.source_cn: 好，那就交换！知己知彼，我们的斗争才能更有意义！

say:45:1260010030:1.text: Carmine Whispers, and Magister, please accept these as well!
say:45:1260010030:1.source_cn: 血薇帮的各位，还有魔法师大人，你们也请收下！
say:45:1260010030:1.male: Carmine Whispers, and Magister, please accept these as well!
say:45:1260010030:1.female: Carmine Whispers, and Magister, please accept these as well!

say:47:1260010031:1.text: No sooner are the words spoken than Hugin, who has just arrived, finds a fish shoved into his hands by the enthusiastic fisherman.
say:47:1260010031:1.source_cn: 话音未落，就连刚刚凑过来的呼金手里也被热情的钓鱼爱好者...

say:48:1260010032:0.text: You arrived just in time! These last fish are yours!
say:48:1260010032:0.source_cn: 这位大师，您来得正巧，这些剩下的鱼就送给您了！

say:51:1260010033:1.text: Oh? Th-thank you, but I don't eat fish...
say:51:1260010033:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯？谢、谢谢，但我不喜欢吃鱼啊……

say:54:1260010034:1.text: Hugin, what brings you here? How are the preparations for the Fall Harvest?
say:54:1260010034:1.source_cn: 呼金，你怎么来了？秋夜节筹备得怎么样了？

say:55:1260010035:1.text: Patience; everything is proceeding according to plan. We just don't have any ideas yet for the gifts of the Fall Harvest exchange.
say:55:1260010035:1.source_cn: 不要催，一切都按照计划和排期进行。只有秋夜节要供给大家...

say:56:1260010036:1.text: Why are you swapping fish already? The Fall Harvest isn't upon us just yet.
say:56:1260010036:1.source_cn: 倒是你们几个，怎么在这里换上鱼了？秋夜节还没到呢。

say:58:1260010037:1.text: Historically, the initial Fall Harvest was all about different peoples exchanging their unique specialties.
say:58:1260010037:1.source_cn: 严格来说，最初的秋夜节，是各个族裔彼此交换自己专属特产...
say:58:1260010037:1.male: Historically, the initial Fall Harvest was all about different peoples exchanging their unique specialties.
say:58:1260010037:1.female: Historically, the initial Fall Harvest was all about different peoples exchanging their unique specialties.

say:59:1260010038:1.text: After all, fall is the season of harvest. Exchanging goods is not only about sharing resources but also showcasing one's own strengths and fostering mutual understanding...
say:59:1260010038:1.source_cn: 毕竟秋天是收获的季节，交换既是互通有无，也是炫耀自身的...

say:60:1260010039:1.source_cn: 后来慢慢就演变成交换些方便好吃的小东西了，比如耀光的麦...

say:67:1260010043:1.text: Ah, come to think of it, the old captain I know did say that Rustport used to celebrate the Fall Harvest!
say:67:1260010043:1.source_cn: 啊，提起这个，我这几天找认识的老船长打听过——早年的锈...

say:68:1260010044:1.text: I get it. Tesio then became busy with leading the Carmine Whispers and fighting various factions, and in recent years, he's also had run-ins with the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:68:1260010044:1.source_cn: 原来如此。后来泰西欧忙着率领血薇帮和各种帮派争斗，这几...

say:69:1260010045:1.text: Amidst the daily fight for survival, we've completely forgotten these local traditions.
say:69:1260010045:1.source_cn: 在日复一日的搏斗生存中，反而这些本地的习俗被我们忘光了。

say:70:1260010046:1.text: Hmm, the old captain said that when he was young, they used to set up a fish market by the sea, exchange catches to celebrate, and even set off fireworks to light up the shore!
say:70:1260010046:1.source_cn: 嗯，老船长说，他小时候，会在海边摆出鱼类集市，大家互相...

say:71:1260010047:1.text: That sounds wonderful, but I haven't seen anything like that in all my life.
say:71:1260010047:1.source_cn: 听起来很不错，可惜从我出生之后都没见过那种景象。

say:73:1260010049:1.text: Yes, fish and fireworks are perfect for Rustport! Great suggestion, I'll run with it!
say:73:1260010049:1.source_cn: 没错，鱼获和礼花正适合锈锚港！好点子，我采纳了！

say:74:1260010050:1.text: I'm going to get back to preparing the festival. Ha, I'll make sure your first Fall Harvest is one you'll always remember!
say:74:1260010050:1.source_cn: 我先回去继续筹备秋夜节了，嚯哈哈哈，要让你们这些娃儿过...

say:75:1260010051:1.text: The hurried clinking of metal prosthetics fades away as Hugin rushes off in a flurry.
say:75:1260010051:1.source_cn: 急促的金属假肢点地声远去，呼金风风火火地离开了。

say:76:1260010052:1.text: Tsk... Whatever Cecia's plans might be, her schemes have strangely worked in our favor!
say:76:1260010052:1.source_cn: 啧……不管那个瑟西娅到底是什么打算，她的阴谋反而又歪打...

say:77:1260010053:1.text: At this rate, the Fall Harvest is bound to be unforgettable!
say:77:1260010053:1.source_cn: 这样下去，这个秋夜节到底会变成什么样子啊……！
